Unicode Test File - Testing Various Character Sets and Encodings
================================================================

1. Basic Latin (ASCII)
   Hello, World! 123 ABC abc

2. Latin Extended
   café, naïve, résumé, piñata, Zürich

3. Greek
   Γειά σου κόσμε (Hello world)
   Αλφάβητο (Alphabet)

4. Cyrillic
   Привет мир (Hello world)
   Алфавит (Alphabet)

5. Arabic
   مرحبا بالعالم (Hello world)
   الأبجدية (Alphabet)

6. Hebrew
   שלום עולם (Hello world)
   אלפבית (Alphabet)

7. Chinese
   你好世界 (Hello world - Simplified)
   你好世界 (Hello world - Traditional)

8. Japanese
   こんにちは世界 (Konnichiwa sekai - Hello world)
   ひらがな (Hiragana)
   カタカナ (Katakana)
   漢字 (Kanji)

9. Korean
   안녕하세요 세계 (Hello world)
   한글 (Hangul)

10. Emoji and Symbols
    😀😁😂🤣😃😄😅😆😇😈
    🌍🌎🌏🌐🗺️
    ❤️🧡💛💚💙💜🖤🤍🤎
    ✅❌⚠️📌🔔💡🎯🚀
    👨‍👩‍👧‍👦👨‍💻👩‍🔬🧑‍🎨

11. Mathematical Symbols
    ∑ ∏ ∫ ∂ ∇ ∆ ∞ ≈ ≠ ≤ ≥
    α β γ δ ε ζ η θ ι κ λ μ

12. Currency Symbols
    $ € £ ¥ ₹ ₽ ¢ ₩ ₪ ₨

13. Box Drawing
    ┌─┬─┐
    │ │ │
    ├─┼─┤
    │ │ │
    └─┴─┘

14. Arrows
    ← ↑ → ↓ ↔ ↕ ⇐ ⇑ ⇒ ⇓ ⇔ ⇕

15. Combining Characters
    é (e + combining acute)
    ñ (n + combining tilde)
    ö (o + combining diaeresis)

16. Zero-Width Characters
    Hello​World (contains zero-width space)
    Test‌ing (contains zero-width non-joiner)
    Ex‍ample (contains zero-width joiner)

17. Right-to-Left Override
    ‏Hello World‏ (RTL override)
    ‎Mixed מעורב Text‎

18. Special Unicode Spaces
    Normal space: " "
    No-break space: " "
    Em space: " "
    En space: " "
    Thin space: " "

19. Control Characters (representation)
    NULL: \0
    Tab: \t
    Line Feed: \n
    Carriage Return: \r

20. Surrogate Pairs
    𝕳𝖊𝖑𝖑𝖔 𝖂𝖔𝖗𝖑𝖉 (Mathematical Bold Fraktur)
    𝓗𝓮𝓵𝓵𝓸 𝓦𝓸𝓻𝓵𝓭 (Mathematical Bold Script)

21. Rare Scripts
    ᚻᛖᛚᛚᚩ (Runic)
    𐌷𐌴𐌻𐌻𐍉 (Gothic)

22. Byte Order Mark
    ﻿This line starts with a UTF-8 BOM

End of Unicode Test File
